== Events ==
* [[Journey]]
* [[Jinjur refuses to give up her throne and declares war on Glinda and Ozma]]
* [[Mombi admits the Wizard gave her the baby Ozma in exchange for teaching her magic tricks]]
* [[The travelers fall unharmed into a hidden Jackdaw's nest full of stolen treasures, and the Woggle-Bug gives a found diamond necklace to the Tin Woodman]]
* [[Jack admits his mistake in assuming an interpreter was needed]]
* [[Tip speaks the magic words he learned from Mombi, and the Thing comes to life, screeching and flapping its wings violently]]
* [[After thinking quietly, the Scarecrow proposes building a flying machine on the roof and using the Powder of Life to animate it, with the Tin Woodman as builder]]
* [[The Army of Revolt surrenders, stolen jewels are returned, and Ozma is crowned queen of the Emerald City]]
* [[Queen Jinjur despairs on learning Mombi confessed and that Tip is truly Princess Ozma]]
* [[Jinjur threatens to destroy each companion in a gruesome way, while ordering Tip returned to old Mombi]]
* [[Nick Chopper amputates Jack's left leg and fits it to the Saw-Horse, prompting bickering between Jack and the Saw-Horse before the group resumes travel toward the Emerald City]]
* [[Discovered, Mombi transforms into a Shadow to flee the tent, but Glinda seals the entrance shut with a wave of her hand]]
* [[Tip suggests restuffing the Scarecrow with the money found in the nest, which the Jackdaws had stolen from towns over the years, and the group refills him with bills of various denominations]]
* [[The Scarecrow discovers he has lost the pepper-box containing the two remaining Wishing Pills, apparently left in the nest]]
* [[Scarecrow proposes seeking advice from Glinda the Good in the South Country, and everyone boards the Gump]]
* [[The Scarecrow declares them friends and leads Jack off to play quoits]]
* [[The Tin Woodman blows a silver whistle to summon the Queen of the Field Mice, an old friend whose life he once saved]]
* [[The Scarecrow declares they cannot stay shut in the palace and calls for a plan of escape]]
* [[Tip dresses the finished figure in clothes found in Mombi's chest and names him 'Jack Pumpkinhead.']]
* [[The group escapes the sunflower field by riding forward with closed eyes, following the Pumpkinhead and Saw-Horse]]
* [[Two girls fell from a window in fright, and while the Professor and pupils rushed to check on them, the Woggle-Bug escaped, now permanently enlarged]]
